verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a SaaS fraud-prevention platform with a merchant console, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only automated fraud-decision APIs, integrations, chargeback handling and an integration validation console. Nothing shows an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The 'Agentforce Commerce' mention is Salesforce platform naming, not a Riskified assistant.
